title: Prove Token Index reads and refreshes through typed backend handlers

intentCoverage.report:
## Dough Intent Coverage

**Caught.** When Refresh rereads the same Codex session after a later launch is kept, the maintained test detects loss of usage on the later launch. This checks the launch ownership example in `SEED-413#renovate-usage-token-index-proof` at `e9699edc1040576b8f103ae170468af38520070d`, recorded in `.planning/seeds/SEED-413-renovate-dashboard-unit-tests.md`.

I temporarily excluded `ad-hoc` launches from the candidates passed to `codexAssociation` inside `dashboard/server/usageRefresh.ts`'s `codexReading`. The fixture records an execution with 100 initial and 300 reply output tokens and a later `/dough-land` turn with 700 output tokens. It refreshes once with only the execution kept, keeps the later launch in the same session, then refreshes again. The maintained case `a later typed workflow starts its own attribution when Refresh finds its kept launch` passed on the original source. Under the fault, the assertion at `dashboard/backend-tests/usage-history/token-index-refresh-developer-reply-codex.spec.ts:153` failed because the later launch's usage was empty where it expected one response with 700 output tokens.

An independent script reproduced the stored contribution using `readUsageHistory` and `taskUsage` on its own scratch data. Before the fault, both the original launch's 400 output tokens and the later launch's 700 output tokens were present after the second refresh. Under the fault the original still had two responses and 400 output tokens, while the later launch had zero responses and no measured output. After the fault run I verified the restored file bytes against their backup and a clean Git state. The same focused check passed again at the original revision, and I removed the isolated checkout.

All three test runs used `caffeinate -s -i env -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_BACKEND_PROOF_RECORD=<separate path> npm run test:dashboard:backend -- 'usage-history/token-index-refresh-developer-reply-codex\.spec\.ts$' --grep 'a later typed workflow starts its own attribution' --workers=2`. The runner exercised one matching case in each run.

**Next proof action.** Retain the current assertion. This probe found no gap requiring a correction for the checked path.

- **Test runtime.** Measured runner durations were 4.34 s baseline, 5.74 s faulted, and 3.57 s restored. The selected case took 395 ms, 646 ms, and 604 ms respectively.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No separate human effort was measured.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. No separate active effort or token measurement was available for this probe.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 158536 ms (measured), from 1795522001000 to 1795522159536 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition for e9699edc1040576b8f103ae170468af38520070d: Caught. No follow-up for the checked attribution path.
